title: Hercules, the strongest boy.
lines: Long ago, in Greece, the gods lived on top of a mountain.
The king of the gods was Zeus.
Hercules was a baby with super strong muscles.
He could already lift a pillar from his cradle.
But there was an angry god, Hades.
He sent two naughty helpers to take the baby away.
There a kind farmer and his wife found him.
When he shook someone's hand, he squeezed too hard.
When he threw a ball, it flew right over the mountains.
He accidentally wrecked a whole market.
The other children called him a klutz.
One day he went to the temple of Zeus.
The statue of Zeus started to talk.
If you become a true hero, you can come back to Olympus.
Zeus gave him a horse with wings.
Together they flew through the sky.
A little man who was half goat.
Phil taught him everything about heroes.
And you must never give up.
He defeated a monster with lots and lots of heads.
He rescued children trapped under big rocks.
There were shoes with his name on them.
Cups with his face on them.
But Hercules still wasn't allowed to go to Olympus.
Hercules jumped into the dark river to rescue her.
Even though it was very dangerous.
At that moment Hercules began to glow.
Now you are a true hero, he said.
A true hero isn't the strongest.
A true hero is someone with a big heart.
Hercules was allowed to go to Olympus.
But he chose to stay on Earth.
